_comment: Stage-5 extraction strategies, keyed by class name. Each class plugs into the SAME small set of strategy methods (the only engine-level vocabulary). New classes = new JSON entries pointing at existing methods. New strategy methods = engine-level ADR. 2026-05-26.
_yume_principle: Everything reusable. Polygons decompose to rotated/scaled prim_unit_box. No new engine primitives. New genres add classes by JSON, not code.

extraction_method.single_instance: One instance at the LARGEST connected-component's centroid. For unique focal objects.
extraction_method.instance_per_component: ONE instance per connected component meeting min_area_px — the 1:1 primitive. With pca_oriented:true, facing + length + thickness come from PCA; else canonical_size + rotation_rule. Use when the semantic map authors each entity as a discrete tile (houses, towers, individually-tiled walls).
extraction_method.cluster_extract: Merge connected components within `cluster_within_meters`. Drops noise + collapses dense roof textures.
extraction_method.snap_to_anchor: Snap to a named structural anchor (focal_anchor, wall_ring_corners, road_intersections). Single or N instances.
extraction_method.scatter_in_mask: Distribute N=density*area instances within a region mask. RNG-seeded.
extraction_method.polygon_decompose: Trace the connected-component contour → Ramer-Douglas-Peucker simplify → emit one rotated prim_unit_box per polygon edge. For continuous walls without per-segment authoring; if walls are pre-tiled, prefer instance_per_component with pca_oriented.
extraction_method.require_adjacent: Like instance_per_component, but only keep components that touch a `must_touch_class` (e.g., bridge must touch water_surface).
extraction_method.llm_gestalt: Single OpenAI vision call enumerates instances with gestalt grouping. For classes where dense semantic-map texture should collapse to fewer larger structures.

rotation_rule.face_nearest_road: CV: vector from instance to nearest cobblestone pixel → facing = atan2 of that vector. House front toward road.
rotation_rule.face_anchor: CV: vector from instance to focal_anchor (plaza centroid) → facing. Townhall faces plaza.
rotation_rule.along_tangent: CV: tangent of the containing polygon at instance position. Wall segments along the wall ring.
rotation_rule.perpendicular_to_water: CV: normal of the water polygon's nearest edge at instance position. Bridge across river.
rotation_rule.random_seeded: RNG with scene seed. Trees, rocks, organic scatter.

y_anchor.heightmap_sample: Sample heightmap.png at (x, z) via the existing HeightmapSampler. Default for ground-anchored objects.
y_anchor.anchor_floor: Match Y of a named anchor entity (e.g., plaza floor). Statues, fountains.
y_anchor.constant: Explicit y value (must specify `y_value_meters` in the class entry).

primitive.prim_unit_box: 1×1×1 unit box. state.scale = [W, H, D] in meters.
primitive.prim_unit_cylinder: radius 0.5, height 1.0. state.scale = [W, H, D] (X×Z scale both diameters).

house._comment: FIT-TO-MASK + FLOOR TIERS (2026-05-27): each house box's footprint (X x Z) + yaw are fitted to its detected tile's PCA bbox; the bucket (by area) picks the ALBEDO tier, the HEIGHT, AND the floor-tiered kit. small=1 floor (house_1f, ~3.5m), medium=2 floors (house_2f, ~6.5m), large=3 floors (house_3f, ~9.5m). Heights were cut from 6/8/11 to 3.5/6.5/9.5 so a fitted ~2m footprint no longer reads as a thin tower; each kit shows 1/2/3 window rows + floor-divider trim so the storey count is legible. use_canonical_scale:false → per-instance fitted footprint, bucket height.

wall_segment._comment: FIT-TO-MASK: each wall segment's LENGTH + thickness are fitted to its detected tile (PCA), height from canonical_size_meters[1]=3m. Canonical (fixed-length) walls broke the ring once the world size derived larger than the tuned 11m — fitted length spans the tile at ANY world scale, so the ring always closes. wall_kit adds a cap + crenellation merlons. 2026-05-27.

tower._comment: FIT-TO-MASK: tower DIAMETER fits its detected blob so it bridges the gap between adjacent wall segments at any world scale; height from canonical_size_meters[1]=5m (towers rise above the 3m walls). min_elongation 1.6 keeps round blobs unrotated. Fixed 1.5m towers left gaps once the world derived larger. 2026-05-27.

bridge._comment: PCA-oriented across the river. Each bridge component is one bridge; require_adjacent filters out same-color components not touching water. bridge_kit adds side railings + end abutments to the deck.

stone_totem.mesh_reference_prompt: a single giant ancient carved stone bird totem — a tall vertical stone monolith pillar with a stylized eagle/owl head and a curved hooked beak at the very top, tribal glyphs carved down the shaft, mossy weathered grey granite, a wide square base, the whole statue centered and standing upright
stone_totem.mesh_prompt: giant ancient carved stone bird totem statue, weathered mossy grey granite, upright on a wide stone base
stone_totem._comment: Giant ancient stone bird totem — a focal landmark. asset_source:tripo (complex hero → CONCEPT image (hero-style-conditioned) then image_to_model); bird_totem_kit is the code FALLBACK until the .glb is generated + the engine auto-normalizes it into the fitted placement. FIT-TO-MASK footprint, GIANT fixed height (canonical[1]=16m). 2026-05-27.

ruins.mesh_reference_prompt: a single cluster of ancient ruined stone — broken weathered sandstone columns of different heights, a crumbling low wall fragment, and a fallen carved block, moss and cracks, all grouped together resting on flat ground, centered
ruins.mesh_prompt: ancient broken sandstone ruins cluster, toppled mossy columns and a crumbling wall fragment
ruins._comment: Broken ancient ruins. asset_source:tripo (complex → CONCEPT image (hero-style-conditioned) then image_to_model); ruin_kit is the FALLBACK until generated. FIT-TO-MASK length/thickness via PCA, fixed low height (3m). albedo = sandstone. 2026-05-27.

tree._comment: Scatters within the 'forest' biome mask, OR (when no forest class exists in the scene) within its OWN 'tree' mask — see lib_extract_v2._extract_scatter own-mask fallback (2026-05-27). Renders as tree_round kit (trunk + foliage puffs), foliage = albedo #3a8f44; canonical footprint widened to 2.5m so the rounded canopy reads as a tree, not a pole.

rock._comment: Rock clusters scattered within the rock semantic mask, own-mask fallback when no rock class is upstream (2026-05-28). Kit-of-parts (5-sphere boulder pile), per-instance scale jitter for silhouette variety. Tripo upgrade (single rock_cluster glb) is a future option but the kit covers many instances cheaply.

class_aliases._comment: Map per-scene class names to canonical strategy entries. Lets the catalog skill recognize 'small_house', 'noble_house', 'tower_round' etc and route to the right strategy.

default_strategy._comment: Used when a class name doesn't match any entry or alias. Conservative default: one instance per blob, no rotation, box primitive sized to the bbox.

_authoring_note: Stage 5 v2's strategy dispatcher (lib_extract_v2.py) looks up classes here by name. yume-scene-class-catalog injects the matched strategy block into the per-scene catalog. New genres: add classes here (or via alias) — NO engine code change.
